candidates.title: Specification discipline
candidates.trigger: Unspecified new capability or meaningful requirements ambiguity
candidates.acceptance: Mapped to existing PROJECT_MASTER_SPEC without replacing approved baseline

candidates.title: Incremental implementation
candidates.acceptance: Small independently tested change set; no simultaneous competing implementers

candidates.title: Test-driven development
candidates.trigger: Code behavior change or bug fix
candidates.acceptance: Reproducing failing test followed by passing test evidence

candidates.title: Browser runtime verification
candidates.acceptance: Real-browser evidence with approved browser tooling; no unreviewed MCP auto-install

candidates.title: Security and hardening
candidates.trigger: Identity, payments, user data or integrations
candidates.acceptance: Threat boundary and authorization checks; no secret exposure

candidates.title: CI/CD verification
candidates.acceptance: PR checks and rollback plan, without enabling deploy

candidates.title: Service level objectives
candidates.acceptance: Metrics and failure thresholds defined without logging private content

candidates.title: Growth experiments
candidates.trigger: Product pilot needs measurable user acquisition or revenue validation
candidates.acceptance: One consent-respecting experiment with target metric and real cost accounting
